mapper.update: UPDATE approval_task SET status = #{status}, decision_type = #{decisionType}, decision_reason = #{reason}, decision_intent_key = #{decisionIntentKey}, decided_at = #{now}, decided_by_user_id = #{actorId}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by_type = 'USER', updated_by_id = #{actorId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND approval_task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND approver_user_id = #{actorId} AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE workflow_instance SET lock_version=lock_version+1,updated_at=#{now},updated_by_type='USER',updated_by_id=#{actorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND workflow_instance_id=#{instanceId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lock_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_task (tenant_id, approval_task_id, workflow_instance_id, level_no, approver_user_id, status, lock_version, created_at, created_by_type, updated_at, updated_by_type) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{workflowInstanceId}, 2, #{approverUserId}, 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, 'SERVICE', #{now}, 'SERVICE')
mapper.sql: SELECT i.workflow_instance_id, i.ticket_id, i.start_intent_key, i.definition_id, i.workflow_version_id, i.workflow_version_no, i.input_snapshot_json, i.input_snapshot_sha256, i.condition_result, i.status, i.current_level, i.started_at, i.completed_at, i.lock_version, i.created_at, i.updated_at, start_inbox.message_id AS start_message_id, i.updated_by_id AS last_actor_id FROM workflow_instance i LEFT JOIN inbox_message start_inbox ON start_inbox.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND start_inbox.result_type = 'WORKFLOW_INSTANCE' AND start_inbox.result_id = i.workflow_instance_id

SELECT approval_task_id, workflow_instance_id, level_no, approver_user_id, status, decision_type, decision_reason, decision_intent_key, decided_at, decided_by_user_id, lock_version, created_at, updated_at FROM approval_task

SELECT COALESCE(o.approver_user_id,v.level2_approver_user_id) AS approver_user_id FROM workflow_instance i JOIN workflow_version v ON v.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND v.workflow_version_id=i.workflow_version_id AND v.definition_id=i.definition_id AND v.version_no=i.workflow_version_no LEFT JOIN workflow_approver_override o ON o.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND o.workflow_instance_id=i.workflow_instance_id AND o.level_no=2 WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.workflow_instance_id=#{workflowInstanceId}
